name: Gary chart expression
authority: Expression rules and opt-in SVG reference policy; domain examples are not normative

colorRules.primary: Main measure or a declared emphasis; not a fixed industry field, brand button or good outcome
colorRules.secondary: Secondary measure; legacy reference role. Use semanticStates for declared outcomes
colorRules.reference: Accented reference retained for the SVG reference recipes; referenceNeutral is the quiet reference default for new charts
colorRules.negative: Signed negative contribution in reference recipes; sign alone never establishes harm, failure or a market convention
colorRules.binding: Persist stable entity ID -> role in normalized input before sorting/filtering; reuse that binding across chart, table, legend and export. Never derive identity from current index
mustNot: Colour is not the only identifier
Do not give the same colour contradictory meanings in one view without separating and naming the encodings
No rainbow per item without categorical need
No pointer lighting changes data colours
Do not silently turn null/unknown into zero or neutral midpoint
Do not automatically recolour analytical identities from wallpaper, imagery or a brand theme
Do not infer universal colour-blind safety from contrast ratios
colorRules.registry: All chart color literals live only in themes. colorSystem palettes and semantic mappings contain role references, not copied hex arrays
colorRules.label: Use text/muted on the chart background; a colored label still meets normalTextMin. On a filled mark, select a tested onFill role against the final composite color

typography.family: Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, Microsoft YaHei UI, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
typography.precision: From input accuracy, never invented; units in axes/table headers
typography.wrapping: Wrap or move full labels outside plot before reducing text; never silently truncate

noDecoration: no duplicated page grid inside cards

contrast.secondaryGridExempt: Only if positions remain understandable from axes/labels; primary data marks are not exempt

annotations.coordinateSpace: Data value/category identity; convert to pixels at render, not copied screenshot coordinates
annotations.collision: Reserve space or move annotation outside; never place a label over a value, axis or mark
annotations.uncertainty: Show assumed thresholds and unknowns as such; a coloured band is not evidence
annotations.recompute: Changing source data must recompute or invalidate derived annotations

data.missing: null means missing, never zero; finite numbers only; no interpolation without a declared method
data.scales: Explicit unit and domain, include every observed value; comparative bars/areas include zero; matching small multiples share limits
data.aggregate: Declare denominator/weight/baseline; totals and derived labels use the same source as marks and tables
data.zeroState: All-zero part-to-whole cannot form a percentage ring; show an empty state/table
data.validation: Reject invalid data before replacing the displayed chart; error text identifies the field

layout.reading: Question + one major chart + bounded explanation + source; details stay near the evidence
layout.analysis: Common scales and stable Solid surfaces; comparison before decorative symmetry
layout.presentation: One finding per frame, fewer labels with accessible exact values, export same meaning
layout.responsive: Reflow legend, annotations and tables; wide ordinal charts may locally scroll with an explicit cue; compact charts must fit; never page-level overflow
layout.material: Solid for marks/tables; Frosted for separate summary/navigation; Optical for short showcase content only
layout.motion: Static is complete. Optional reveal finite and cancellable; decoration default off via Background; tooltip/focus remain usable
layout.export: Preserve units, source status, scale, labels and data; rebuild theme colours, not whole-image inversion; verify the actual file

families.label: 趋势线
families.question: 量值随连续时间怎样变化？
families.avoid: Unordered categories or unrelated observation intervals connected as a trend

families.label: 面积图
families.question: 连续量的规模与累积怎样变化？
families.avoid: Overlapping opaque areas or showing tiny differences as large filled mass

families.label: 条形比较
families.question: 对象之间相差多少？
families.avoid: Non-zero cut baseline or many colours without categorical meaning

families.label: 分组比较
families.question: 少量系列在各对象中如何比较？
families.encoding: adjacent bars sharing zero and category bands
families.avoid: Dense groups that require eye-tracking many repeated colours

families.label: 百分比构成
families.question: 各组的内部构成有何不同？
families.avoid: Suggesting equal lengths mean equal absolute sizes

families.label: 双轴叠合
families.question: 同一分类下两个不同单位的量如何共同观察？
requires: reason to overlay instead of split
families.encoding: bar primary + line secondary; separate scale labels
must: no scale tuning to imply correlation
families.avoid: Same-unit measures using separate scales; arbitrary category trend; causal inference from shape

families.label: 贡献瀑布
families.question: 起点经过哪些增减得到终点？
must: domain covers negative and positive cumulative values
families.avoid: Non-additive rates or loosely related benefits assembled into a net total

families.label: 点图与散点
families.question: 两个数值如何关联或分布？
families.encoding: x/y position; size only for a defined third variable
families.avoid: Causal claims, invented quadrant thresholds, decorative bubbles

families.label: 分布直方
families.question: 观测值集中在哪里，有没有长尾？
families.encoding: contiguous intervals, frequency or density with declared denominator
must: same bin widths or density correction
families.avoid: Treating categories as numeric bins or hiding results by manipulating bins

families.label: 箱线分布
families.question: 中位数、离散度和异常观测如何比较？
must: do not infer distribution from averages

families.label: 矩阵热图
families.question: 两个分类组合的强弱聚集在哪里？
must: sequential or divergent scale matches meaning
families.avoid: Arbitrary rainbow or independently normalised cells without disclosure

families.label: 环形构成
families.question: 一个总体由哪些部分组成？
must: no negative arc for zero/small parts
families.avoid: Fine ranking, progress without a denominator, implying confidence probability

families.label: 多维轮廓
families.question: 同一对象在少量已定义维度上的轮廓如何？
families.encoding: radial positions on named dimensions; thin reference polygon
families.avoid: Incomparable units or claiming bigger shape means better

families.label: 方向与周期
families.question: 量值沿真实方向或周期如何分布？
families.encoding: angle gives direction/phase; radius or area encodes stated measure
families.avoid: Putting arbitrary categories in a circle or confusing radius with area

families.label: 精确数据表
families.question: 怎样核对完整的精确值和来源？
families.encoding: aligned text, tabular numbers, optional subordinate in-cell bars
families.avoid: Manual duplicated totals, visual-only labels or decorations replacing values
families.alternative: bar for overview, retain table for precision

families.label: 小多图
families.question: 多组相同指标的模式有什么差异？
families.avoid: Each panel auto-ranging into an apparently similar trend

families.label: 区间与误差
families.question: 估计范围有多宽，怎样与基准比较？
families.avoid: Invented error bars or calling scenario extremes a confidence interval

provenance.visualReference: User-selected GarchOS chart expressions; interpreted as design evidence, not a template or data source
provenance.extractionMethod: reference element -> communicative function -> invariant rule -> parameters -> counterexample -> cross-domain test

ownership.interface: tokens/tokens.json remains authoritative for UI text, surfaces, focus and control states
ownership.scene: spec/scene-recipes.json governs scene/material/motion and existing adapter defaults; its chartCategory remains legacy and is not silently synchronized by this addition
ownership.adoption: Opt-in chart policy; other renderers must explicitly map these roles and verify current output. No claim of automatic adoption across all adapters

categorical6.label: 分类 · 六色
requiredRedundancy: marker shape or dash for overlapping series
categorical6.binding: Freeze entity ID -> role once; additions must not renumber earlier entities

categorical8.label: 分类 · 八色扩展
use: a necessary 7-8 entity overview with room for direct labels
requiredRedundancy: direct name or keyed pattern for every category
inspect all colour-vision modes and grayscale
categorical8.preferredAlternative: Small multiples, grouped bars or a ranked table. Eight swatches are capacity, not proof of perceptual separability

sequential7.label: 连续量 · 七级青色
sequential7.valueType: nonnegative magnitude or explicitly ordered score
avoid: signed deviations around a meaningful midpoint
requiredRedundancy: legend with unit and explicit domain/breaks
visible boundary if a low-intensity mark is essential
sequential7.mapping: Declare [min,max] and equal-width/quantile/custom breaks. Use seven discrete stops by default; interpolation is a renderer choice requiring renewed order/contrast checks

diverging7.label: 偏差 · 七级蓝灰陶色
requiredRedundancy: shared symmetric extent for like-for-like magnitude comparison
diverging7.mapping: Use [-M,0,+M] for signed magnitudes when justified; a nonzero or asymmetric midpoint/domain must be explicit. Blue/rust are below/above roles, not a value judgement
diverging7.neutralBin: Exact declared midpoint by default; a nonzero tolerance must state its numeric width and unit. Never silently merge small signed values into zero

neutralRoles.missingTreatment: Hatch or outlined empty cell plus explicit missing text; zero retains its real numeric encoding

info.label: 信息
info.requires: Named observation; not an assurance of correctness

positive.label: 已达到
positive.requires: Explicit satisfied criterion or completed process

critical.label: 未满足
critical.requires: Explicit failed criterion or adverse condition

unknown.label: 未知
unknown.requires: Missing evidence; do not infer a pass or fail

defaultSignedChange.meaning: Amount increases/decreases, not good/bad; retain +/− and values

cn-stock.meaning: Explicit red-rise/green-fall task convention; financial direction is independent from semanticStates

green-up-market.meaning: Use only when that market or user explicitly requires green-rise/red-fall; never infer from interface language

labelOnFill.selection: Choose the candidate with the higher contrast against the actual composed fill; require contrast.normalTextMin without rounding. If neither qualifies, move the label onto background or give it a solid plate
labelOnFill.forbidden: Do not choose white for every coloured fill, or text against only the uncomposited source hue

redundancy.policy: Use names plus shapes/patterns or separate panels; shape/dash arrays are a design vocabulary, not permission for eight crossing lines
redundancy.checkStatus: Required per actual chart; no all-CVD-safe claim for these swatches
redundancy.adjacency: Check the colours that actually touch. If identity depends on their boundary, supply a separator/outline that itself remains visible; background contrast alone does not establish pairwise distinction

validation.continuousFills: Sequential/diverging pale or dark-low stops are not universally 3:1 against background. Essential boundaries and legend/value redundancy are mandatory; never use those stops as small-text colours
validation.gradients: A faded area/column uses an opaque outline or endpoint marker with >= essentialMarksMin against the relevant background, plus an exact value/axis. Test stops and the lowest-opacity boundary after alpha compositing
validation.point: The light-theme white point fill needs its visible series-colour stroke; point alone is not an essentialMarks pass
validation.matrix: Both themes × actual surface × opacity × neighbours × colour-vision/grayscale × target export. Contrast math is one gate, not final visual acceptance

sources.title: Apple HIG Color
sources.supports: Inclusive colour, appearance-aware use and cultural interpretation

sources.title: Apple HIG Charts
sources.supports: Meaningful colour plus shapes/patterns, contiguous mark separation and accessible descriptions

sources.title: Google Android Color for mobile design
sources.supports: Material 3 semantic colour roles, paired foreground/container roles and independent light/dark tone assignments

sources.title: Google Material 2 The color system
sources.supports: Older official guidance permits extra colours for data categories outside the main UI theme; not a claim of current M3 statistical palette prescriptions

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Contrast minimum
sources.supports: Text contrast calculation and unrounded threshold

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Non-text contrast
sources.supports: Essential graphical contrast against adjacent colours

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Use of color
sources.supports: Colour is not the sole carrier of information

colorSystem.provenance: Exact swatches, palette counts, family routing and defaults are Gary design decisions informed by official principles. They are not an Apple or Google chart palette, not HCT-generated, and not certified colour-vision-safe

line.rule: 单量用主色，少量独立系列按稳定ID用分类色；参考用中性虚线
line.whenSingle: 只有一个指标或仅需突出一条主线
line.alternative: 交叉过密改小多图，不能仅靠更多颜色辨认

area.rule: 单量主色浅填充加实色边线；可加组成才用固定分类色堆叠
area.whenSingle: 只表达一个总量或同一量的区间
area.alternative: 组成不可加或细差比较改折线

bar.rule: 同一指标柱条同色；只强调有依据的重点，零点共同
bar.whenSingle: 类别只是被比较对象而无持续系列身份
bar.alternative: 多系列比较才选categorical6；极多对象用排序与明细

grouped-bar.rule: 系列按稳定ID分色，跨组映射不变；同单位共同尺度
grouped-bar.whenSingle: 仅一个系列时退回单色条形
grouped-bar.alternative: 超过六系列先小多图；七八色仅允许直接标注且经过色觉检查

stacked-bar-100.rule: 互斥组成按稳定ID分色，固定顺序；相邻段需可辨边界
stacked-bar-100.whenSingle: 只有一项组成时无须制造颜色层次
stacked-bar-100.alternative: 细小段给外置名称和表格；类别过多改表或小多图

dual-axis.rule: 两个量各一种已声明颜色，并用柱与线区分；轴标签对应量
dual-axis.whenSingle: 可改同轴或对齐小多图时优先各用单主色
dual-axis.alternative: 同单位禁止用独立轴；颜色不能暗示相关性

waterfall.rule: 增减方向按任务约定，终值中性；颜色不判断好坏
waterfall.whenSingle: 仅比较同向贡献时单主色，参照与总计中性
waterfall.alternative: 不可加的指标改条形，市场涨跌需另声明地区约定

point-scatter.rule: 无第三变量先单色；真实分组可用分类色；量值色阶须另给单位与色条
point-scatter.whenSingle: 一个样本集合且没有需要表达的分组或第三量
point-scatter.alternative: 点密集先分箱或小多图，不随机上色

histogram.rule: 一个分布单主色，共同比例和分箱；少量组用分类色或分面
histogram.whenSingle: 只展示一组样本的分布
histogram.alternative: 多组重叠不可辨时先小多图

boxplot.rule: 同类分布中性或主色；有持续分组身份时分类色，异常点仍有标签/形状
boxplot.whenSingle: 只比较各组同一量的分布
boxplot.alternative: 同图颜色过多时用分面，不能用色彩暗示未提供的显著性

heatmap.rule: 非负强度用连续色阶，有明确基准的偏差用发散色阶；图例与缺测独立
heatmap.whenSingle: 不需要量值编码时用中性数字表，不给每格染色
heatmap.alternative: 精确读数为主时保留表格；跨组比较不能各行独立重设色域

donut.rule: 互斥组成稳定分色，中心值同源派生，零和缺测分别处理
donut.whenSingle: 单一进度有合法分母时只用主色与中性轨道
donut.alternative: 默认最多六类；七八类先条形/表格，不能靠近似颜色匹配小图例

radar.rule: 一个对象主色轮廓，参照中性虚线；少量方案才用分类色与点形
radar.whenSingle: 一个对象和一个已说明的参考轮廓
radar.alternative: 轮廓遮挡或维度难读改分组条形/表格

polar-rose.rule: 一个量沿真实周期/方向用单色；额外量才用具名色阶
polar-rose.whenSingle: 半径已表达唯一量时不重复制造分类色
polar-rose.alternative: 普通类别改条形，连续颜色须说明独立变量

table.rule: 文字和底色中性；从属量值色阶/状态必须有原值与定义
table.whenSingle: 查数、计算、核验为主时保持中性，不用填色替代数字
table.alternative: 列过多先按任务分组；未知用文字/斜纹，不能涂成中点

small-multiples.rule: 同对象同角色，共同比较范围；每个面板不自动换色
small-multiples.whenSingle: 重复的是同一个量/对象时全部复用同一主色
small-multiples.alternative: 多对象比较才用稳定分类绑定，不按面板序号生成颜色

range-error.rule: 估计与范围用同角色，浅带有实色边界；参照中性虚线
range-error.whenSingle: 一个估计系列与其合法区间
range-error.alternative: 类别过多用分面；颜色透明度不表示概率
